description: Production deploys of cmux.com (Vercel project cmux) between 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-22. Each case is the previously deployed commit (VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA), the commit Vercel then built, how many commits apart they are, and every path that range changed. webBuildInputsChanged is the answer a full clone gives. Every case with false was built and deployed anyway: Vercel's clone is 10 commits deep, so the previous commit was outside it, and the script could not fetch it.
